# leaseweb_object_storages (Data Source)

List all object storages

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all object storages
data "leaseweb_object_storages" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `object_storages` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--object_storages))

<a id="nestedatt--object_storages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `object_storages`

Read-Only:

- `contract_id` (String) ID of the contract the object storage belongs to
- `customer_id` (String) ID of the customer the object storage belongs to
- `description` (String) Description of the object storage
- `id` (String) Object storage ID
- `quantity` (String) Quantity of the object storage
- `region_url` (String) The region specific endpoint URL for this object storage
- `sales_org_id` (String) Sales organization ID of the object storage
